claim: UNEDasiss accreditation can be requested from 4 February to 1 December each year. For 2026/27 the deadline for international students to request admission to public universities was 7 July 2026, with pending documents accepted until 31 July. Public universities usually close preinscripción in early July, and some differ.
excerpt: El plazo para solicitar la acreditación de UNEDasiss on line, se abre el 4 de febrero y se cierra el 1 de diciembre de cada año. […] Las universidades públicas suelen cerrar su plazo de preinscripción en los primeros días del mes de julio, aunque algunas pueden tener plazos distintos.
interpretation: What a student gets wrong: the real deadline is the university's preinscripción in early July (7 July for 2026/27), one day after IB results on 6 July, not the 1 December end of the UNEDasiss window. UNED says to apply even if the accreditation has not arrived and send the paperwork by 31 July. The page is headed 'Fechas clave 2026' and covers 2026/27 only; the 4 February–1 December window is stated as an annual rule, so it is the only date carried forward to 2027.

attestation.by: the Southern Europe floor pass (es, pt, it)
attestation.note: Read in Spanish. Nothing for 2027/28 published yet.

claim: The UNEDasiss accreditation is a digital certificate that lets a student take part in Spanish university admission. UNED calculates an admission grade of 5 to 10; universities can add up to 4 points from subject tests, to a maximum of 14.
excerpt: La Acreditación UNEDasiss es un certificado digital que permite al alumno participar en los procesos de admisión a la universidad en España
interpretation: The FAQ does not mention the IB by name; that IB holders use this route is established by RD 534/2024 and by the Catalan government's access page.

attestation.by: the Southern Europe floor pass (es, pt, it)

publisher: Boletín Oficial del Estado — Real Decreto 534/2024
claim: Holders of the IB Diploma, like holders of a Técnico Superior title in vocational training, plastic arts and design or sport, are exempt from the Spanish university access test, provided they meet the academic requirements for university access in their system.
excerpt: quedarán exentos de la realización de esta prueba quienes hayan obtenido un título de Técnico Superior de Formación Profesional, de Técnico Superior de Artes Plásticas y Diseño o de Técnico Deportivo Superior, así como aquellos que se encuentren en posesión del título de Bachillerato Europeo o del Diploma del Bachillerato Internacional
interpretation: The rule that puts the IB Diploma on the same footing as a Spanish Bachillerato for access, with no homologation. The same text names the non-university higher routes (Técnico Superior in FP, in Artes Plásticas y Diseño, and Enseñanzas Artísticas Superiores), which is why the sector landscape cites it. Article 6.1(c) names the IB Diploma and 6.2 says no homologation is needed; article 23.3 takes the grade obtained in the foreign system as the access grade. Re-read 2026-09-24 in the consolidated text last updated 2 July 2026: RD 482/2025 amended the transitional provision, and RD 535/2026 amended article 23.2 (vocational titles only). Neither changes the IB rule.

attestation.by: the Southern Europe floor pass (es, pt, it)
attestation.note: Read in Spanish from the consolidated text; the excerpt is from the preamble. Re-read by the Southern Europe audit on 2026-09-24.

claim: An IB student applying to a public university in Catalonia makes one preinscripció universitària through the Generalitat's university access portal.
excerpt: Facis la preinscripció universitària que has de tramitar al Portal d'accés a la universitat
interpretation: Catalonia's public universities (UB, UAB, UPF, UPC among those listed here) share one regional preinscripció, so one application covers them. Madrid's public universities were not re-read; UNED says each university's own preinscripción calendar applies. The Generalitat's own access portal (accesuniversitat.gencat.cat) answered HTTP 403 to automated fetch.
